memories.text:
- Epilepsy
  - Status: Stable on levetiracetam 500 mg BD and lamotrigine 50 mg BD, no seizures in last 3 months.
  - Plan: Continue current AEDs, counsel on sleep hygiene and trigger avoidance.
- Iron‑deficiency anaemia
  - Status: Fatigue persisting, Hb low, ferritin low.
  - Plan: Start ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD plus 200 mg on alternate days, take with vitamin C, review in 6 weeks.
- General

memories.text: EEG: Background activity normal, no epileptiform discharges; no clinical correlation with seizures.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling well, no seizures since May. My periods are regular and I haven’t noticed any heavy bleeding. The iron tablets on alternate days were stopped, I feel less nauseous now. I’d like to continue the once‑daily iron for another month then stop if labs are normal.
